Regression Analaysis for CpGs_INT (exposure) and outcomes (eGFRs, Log(uACR), ESRD) [WHITE ONLY]


```{r}

#### WHITE ##### CpG and ESRD
cpg_int_vars <- c(
  "cg07839457", "cg11699125", "cg16411857", "cg21979287", "cg16936953",
  "cg18942579", "cg01059398", "cg16306654", "cg09801824", "cg23387863",
  "cg03425812", "cg12828896", "cg00490406", "cg10636246", "cg03753191",
  "cg23904266", "cg12054453", "cg09249800", "cg08818207", "cg07878065",
  "cg02068052", "cg03957124", "cg27537252", "cg01409343", "cg13575798",
  "cg24741430", "cg04176813", "cg26140475", "cg14496081", "cg07830828"
)

cox_results_list <- list()

for (cpg in cpg_int_vars) {
  W_reg <- as.formula(paste(
    "Surv(fu_esrd50_def1_v1, inc_esrd50crcys_def1_v5) ~", 
    cpg, "+ GENDER51 + V5AGE51 + CENTER"
  ))
  
 # --- White only ---
 
 white_model <- coxph(W_reg, data = subset(ewas_merged, RACEGRP51 == "W"))
white_summary <- summary(white_model)
  if (cpg %in% rownames(white_summary$coefficients)) {
    coef_row <- white_summary$coefficients[cpg, ]
    cox_results_list[[cpg]] <- data.frame(
      CpG = cpg,
      Beta = coef_row["coef"],
      HR = exp(coef_row["coef"]),
      HR_CI_lower = exp(coef_row["coef"] - 1.96 * coef_row["se(coef)"]),
      HR_CI_upper = exp(coef_row["coef"] + 1.96 * coef_row["se(coef)"]),
      StdError = coef_row["se(coef)"],
      zValue = coef_row["z"],
      pValue = coef_row["Pr(>|z|)"]
    )
  }
}

cox_results_white <- do.call(rbind, cox_results_list)

print(cox_results_white)

```




```{r}

#CpGs and eGFR [WHITE ONLY]

# Initialize a list to store results
results_list <- list()

# Loop through each CpG and run linear regression
for (cpg in cpg_int_vars) {
  formula <- as.formula(paste("egfrcrcys_v5 ~", cpg, "+ V5AGE51 + GENDER51 + CENTER"))
  white_model <- lm(formula, data = subset(ewas_merged,RACEGRP51=="W"))
  model_summary <- summary(white_model)
  
if (cpg %in% rownames(model_summary$coefficients)) {
    coef_row <- model_summary$coefficients[cpg, ]
    
    # Store results
    results_list[[cpg]] <- data.frame(
      CpG = cpg,
      Beta = coef_row["Estimate"],
      StdError = coef_row["Std. Error"],
      tValue = coef_row["t value"],
      pValue = coef_row["Pr(>|t|)"]
    )
  }
}

# Combine all into one data frame
egfr_results <- do.call(rbind, results_list)

# View the result
print(egfr_results)


```


```{r}
# CpGs and log (uACR)

ewas_merged$log_acr_v5 <- log(ewas_merged$acr_v5)

# Initialize results list
results_list <- list()

# Loop through each CpG and run linear regression
for (cpg in cpg_int_vars) {
  # Create model formula
  formula <- as.formula(paste("log_acr_v5 ~", cpg, "+ V5AGE51 + GENDER51 + CENTER"))
  
  # Fit model
  uacr_model <- lm(formula, data = subset(ewas_merged,RACEGRP51=="W"))
  
  # Print model summary
  cat("\n==========\nLinear regression for", cpg, "\n")
  print(summary(uacr_model))
  
  # Extract model summary
  uacr_summary <- summary(uacr_model)
  
  # Only proceed if CpG is in model
  if (cpg %in% rownames(uacr_summary$coefficients)) {
    coef_row <- uacr_summary$coefficients[cpg, ]
    
    # Store results
    results_list[[cpg]] <- data.frame(
      CpG = cpg,
      Beta = coef_row["Estimate"],
      StdError = coef_row["Std. Error"],
      tValue = coef_row["t value"],
      pValue = coef_row["Pr(>|t|)"]
    )
  } else {
    warning(paste("CpG", cpg, "not found in model coefficients"))
  }
}

# Combine into one data frame
uacr_results <- do.call(rbind, results_list)

# View results
print(uacr_results)

```

Heatmap

```{r}
# Extract beta and p-value, renaming for merge

egfr <- egfr_results[, c("CpG", "Beta", "pValue")]
colnames(egfr)[2:3] <- c("eGFR", "p_eGFR")

uacr <- uacr_results[, c("CpG", "Beta", "pValue")]
colnames(uacr)[2:3] <- c("log_uACR", "p_uACR")

esrd <- cox_results_white[, c("CpG", "Beta", "pValue")]
colnames(esrd)[2:3] <- c("ESRD", "p_ESRD")

merged <- Reduce(function(x, y) merge(x, y, by = "CpG"), list(egfr, uacr, esrd))
# Melt beta values and p-values
beta_long <- melt(merged[, c("CpG", "eGFR", "log_uACR", "ESRD")], id.vars = "CpG")
pval_long <- melt(merged[, c("CpG", "p_eGFR", "p_uACR", "p_ESRD")], id.vars = "CpG")

# Align p-values with beta
pval_long$variable <- gsub("p_", "", pval_long$variable)

# Merge beta and p-value data
plot_df <- left_join(beta_long, pval_long, by = c("CpG", "variable"))
colnames(plot_df) <- c("CpG", "Outcome", "Beta", "pValue")

# Create significance marker
plot_df$Signif <- ifelse(plot_df$pValue < 0.05, "*", "")


heatmap <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = Outcome, y = CpG, fill = Beta)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = Signif), size = 4, color = "black") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "blue", mid = "white", high = "red", midpoint = 0) +
  labs(title = "CpG Associations with Kidney Outcomes (White Participants)",
       x = "Outcome", y = "CpG Site", fill = "Beta") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6))

ggsave("R:/ARIC/Users/yl13544/02_EWAS_Tryptophan/01 Result/04 Plots/heatmap.png", 
       plot = heatmap, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)

```


```{r}
# Inverse normal transform function
invnorm_transform <- function(x) {
  ranks <- rank(x, na.last = "keep")
  n <- sum(!is.na(ranks))
  qnorm((ranks - 0.5) / n)
}

# Apply to outcomes
ewas_merged$egfr_INT <- invnorm_transform(ewas_merged$egfrcrcys_v5)
ewas_merged$log_uacr_INT <- invnorm_transform(ewas_merged$log_acr_v5)
ewas_merged$acr_INT <- invnorm_transform(ewas_merged$acr_v5)


sum(is.na(ewas_merged$log_acr_v5))
sum(is.na(ewas_merged$egfrcrcys_v5))
```

# Extract beta and p-value, renaming for merge

uacr <- uacr_INT_results[, c("CpG", "Beta", "pValue")]

pval_long <- melt(merged[, c("CpG", "p_eGFR", "p_uACR", "p_ESRD")], id.vars = "CpG")
